name: credit-360-reinvented
title_zh: 商业信贷客户经理的关系驾驶舱，装进 Cowork 里
tagline_zh: 客户、额度、敞口、还款记录散在五个系统里，翻完一圈客户电话早挂了。它把这些压成一块随问随答的关系面板。
tagline_en: Client, limit, exposure and repayment history live in five systems; by the time you finish digging, the call is.
desc_en: Credit 360: the relationship cockpit for commercial bankers, as a Cowork plugin. Author Fabian Goetzens.
why_zh: 不是又一个 CRM 前端，而是把授信关系当成一张可追问的图：谁和谁关联、敞口怎么滚起来，一次问清。
why_en: Not another CRM front end — it models the credit relationship as a queryable graph: who links to whom, how exposure rolls up.
limit_zh: 只覆盖商业银行对公信贷这一格，零售、投行、保险用不上；数据得你自己接进 Cowork 的上下文，插件本身不带数据源。
limit_en: Only covers commercial/corporate credit — no retail, IB or insurance. You must feed data into Cowork yourself; no built-in sources, no audit trail.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A commercial banker's credit relationship cockpit, inside.
